### About Me

My name is Luca Alioto, and I'm a first-year Master of Urban and Regional Planning student (or MURP for short) in the Luskin School of Public Affairs at UCLA. This past spring I completed my undergrad at UC Davis, studying Political Science and Community Development.

My approach to planning and politics lives at the intersection of theory and practice, making me an individual with the hard skills of policy and quantitative human-driven research expertise, created through community and personal engagement; an understanding that comes from passion and involvement.

My current research spans three areas: refining my honors thesis on political violence and democratic backsliding in El Salvador, the development of a manuscript on housing and transportation policy analysis, and research assistant work on job accessibility.
